provenance_findings: Underworld six small sprites are deterministic cropped/nearest-resized derivatives of one source_enemies.png, not six independently generated animation sets; actors_build.json and generation_calls.json retain exact source/prompt/regions.

Four v8 sheets retain original imagegen PNGs and per-sheet provenance; Underworld charger/diver verbatim original prompts explicitly unavailable (only reconstructed brief), model and license unknown; legacy two have generation-result exact prompt records.

meadow_actions README/manifest establish imagegen original unchanged sheets and style reference; inspected family has no per-call prompt/model/license grant recorded in the family manifest. Any aggregate asset_records found in asset_catalog are inventory, not a new license instrument.

RootBell source provenance labels project-original AI generated but v3-root-bell and burst quality asset_records correctly retain license_status unknown; provenance phrase is not verified commercial license.

Old source folders/docs say six action poses exist; current selection code must decide frame usage. No state enum, distinct pixel hash, source registration or test count is treated as visual production quality.
cross_document_inconsistencies: Region Bible lists4named ecological types, runtime has7IDs plus legacy/same-body variants; no explicit one-to-one stable_id/design/archetype/art approval mapping found in original Bible.
Historical D070 describes three types and six-pose playback; current live fixed-master procedures and fan aerial selection differ.
plains-production-cards.md fan_sentry row claims sentry shared cannon master and cannon-neck joints, but aerial=true sends rawscene through old drone atlas branch; Underworld through aerial.png.
Charger old dedicated audit card is frozen historical evidence; live source/path and H-exit prose do not describe current canonicalH3 implementation.

Asset/runtime multiplicity is uneven: dedicated4H+4D only charger/diver, the others mostly static procedural bodies, some have authored action cells but do not consume them. This is a production-method inventory, not an art quality ranking.
